calib.source: l2policy_bench on ampere (RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell), 2026-09-25: DRAM = llm ws=2048 layers=1; L2 = llm ws=32 reps=50; launch = llm ws=1 layers=64 / 64. None of these sizes is in the H1 grid.
